The saved Jotspot page is titled Economics reference reading 2012 and describes Source reading. It contains the marker zzzfresh and a Pure.md link to a Wayback capture of a Clark University economics newsletter. The service reports creation and update at June 1, 2026, 15:26 UTC. This is a weak candidate research artifact, because a research title and proxy link could also be human-authored. Jotspot was already present in the published baseline.

Internal company attribution review (2026-09-28): OpenAI — moderate confidence. The Clark economics newsletter and exact Wayback snapshot (20130531003440, newsletter2012.pdf) also occur in DSEWiki revision AgentCitationEntryEconomicsPDFZZ942@1 on June 1, before this Jotspot page was created that day. AgentClarkCitationPageX7774@1 also uses a Pure.md link to this newsletter. This specific overlap with the OpenAI-linked wiki activity described at https://collusion.wiki is stronger than the generic research title alone; it still does not authenticate the Jotspot author. This label is an internal attribution hypothesis, not a confirmed attribution or a publication-ready conclusion.
data.summary: A Jotspot page titled "Economics reference reading 2012" links through Pure.md to an archived Clark University newsletter. It adds a candidate research artifact; task authorship, AI involvement and coordination are unconfirmed.
